title: Rizia/Turn 1/Houses Briefing Section
description: Briefing about the important houses of Rizia.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""While I'm on the subject, a word a..."
entries.dialogueText: "While I'm on the subject, a word about our houses."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House Toras?""
entries.dialogueText: "House Toras?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House Sazon?""
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House Azaro?""
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Our family currently controls the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our family currently controls the province of Valenqiris as well as the city-state of Iza."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Aside from Iza, which is now under..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aside from Iza, which is now under Rico's governance, all of Brenas is still their territory."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The nobles there swore fealty to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nobles there swore fealty to the crown in exchange for keeping a hold on their cities and their estates."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But the return of Angelica's boy c..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the return of Angelica's boy could test that loyalty. He is their rightful duke, after all, even if he does not admit it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Ah, yes. The rulers of Cardesse-Mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes. The rulers of Cardesse-Montaklar, and the stewards of the Rizian military."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had no idea.""
entries.dialogueText: "I had no idea."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I was saddened to hear. He ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I was saddened to hear. He taught me everything I know."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. A shame I never got to know h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. A shame I never got to know him."
entries.menuText: "Yes. A shame I never got to know him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope the new war councilor is le..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope the new war councilor is less of a hawk."
entries.menuText: "I hope the new war councilor is less of a hawk."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""His daughter Lucita, the Duchess o..."
entries.dialogueText: "His daughter Lucita, the Duchess of Montaklar, was selected to take his place as war and security councilor. You'll meet her later today."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You should also know that factions..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should also know that factions within her province have begun calling for the return of Pales. Again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father was too soft on the Sazo..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father was too soft on the Sazons. I'll keep them in line."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He cannot be a duke and claim to r..."
entries.dialogueText: "He cannot be a duke and claim to represent democratic values at the same time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He lost that title when his father..."
entries.dialogueText: "He lost that title when his father orchestrated my kidnapping."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why? Cardesse-Montaklar is large a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why? Cardesse-Montaklar is large and powerful enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Azaros are warmongers, to a ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaros are warmongers, to a man. Or woman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't let House Azaro down. I'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't let House Azaro down. I'll finish what the General started."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales hasn't been part of Rizia fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales hasn't been part of Rizia for over a century. It's a lost cause."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A contradiction, isn't it? He disc..."
entries.dialogueText: "A contradiction, isn't it? He discourages his fellow Delegates from using the title, but has yet to officially renounce it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""No matter your feelings on the sub..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter your feelings on the subject, I'd advise you to take the house's concerns seriously."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Be careful. We all know how the la..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful. We all know how the last campaign against the Grand Duchy ended."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Maybe so, but given the house's mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe so, but given the house's military might, I'd advise you to take their concerns seriously."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Lucas was a rogue agent. Or so the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucas was a rogue agent. Or so the rest of the house claims."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""At the moment, they're the weakest..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the moment, they're the weakest of the three houses. You'd do well to ensure they stay that way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wouldn't blame them for siding w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't blame them for siding with him after House Toras stole Iza from them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""They betrayed our house and our ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "They betrayed our house and our king. What else could have been done?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As for the others...""
entries.dialogueText: "As for the others..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And finally...""
entries.dialogueText: "And finally..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As for the others...""
entries.dialogueText: "As for the others..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And finally...""
entries.dialogueText: "And finally..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Well. I hope that was helpful.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well. I hope that was helpful."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo glanced at the clock."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo glanced at the clock.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How is Valenqiris doing, now that..."
entries.dialogueText: "How is Valenqiris doing, now that I've left?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Stable as always. With you on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stable as always. With you on the throne, me as Grand Vizier and Rico in Iza, the governing seat has been filled by our distant cousin Hubertus. You recall him, I'm sure."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course, Princess Vina is eligib..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Princess Vina is eligible to take his place as the reigning Duchess once she is deemed fit."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded at my daughter."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded at my daughter.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""In a few years, maybe. I still don..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a few years, maybe. I still don't feel ready."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'll go when I tell you to go.""
entries.dialogueText: "You'll go when I tell you to go."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're already smarter than I was..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're already smarter than I was when I became Duke. But it's your decision."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. I'm not ready for you to liv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I'm not ready for you to live so far away."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina blushed."
entries.dialogueText: Vina blushed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Vina smiled.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Don't worry, Father. I'm here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry, Father. I'm here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina's face flushed."
entries.dialogueText: Vina's face flushed.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Of course, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I allow her to.""
entries.dialogueText: "If I allow her to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's already smarter than I was w..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's already smarter than I was when I became Duke. But I don't want her living so far away."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That depends on whom she marries.""
entries.dialogueText: "That depends on whom she marries."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'm fully aware of that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm fully aware of that."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Completely understandable.""
entries.dialogueText: "Completely understandable."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That goes without saying.""
entries.dialogueText: "That goes without saying."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's really going on in Iza? Has..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's really going on in Iza? Has Rico been well-received as Duke?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's face hardened."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's face hardened.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo tapped his fingers on the tabl..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo tapped his fingers on the table.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""In any case, Your Majesty, I don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, Your Majesty, I don't expect any trouble in Valenqiris during your reign. It remains the wealthiest of Rizia's provinces, and the least affected by crime."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Iza has been difficult since the S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Iza has been difficult since the Sazon rebellion. Even more so since the Wehzek population there exploded."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Any effort to restore the rights a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any effort to restore the rights and privileges of native Rizians is met with resistance. The students at Iza University are leading the charge, I believe."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Considering the circumstances, I b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Considering the circumstances, I believe my son is doing just fine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about Rizia Imperii? We contr..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about Rizia Imperii? We control that too, don't we?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As for the other houses...""
entries.dialogueText: "As for the other houses..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And finally...""
entries.dialogueText: "And finally..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Make sure their lives don't get an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Make sure their lives don't get any less comfortable, and the local nobility will stay loyal to you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes, Porte Drazon and its metropol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Porte Drazon and its metropolitan area are controlled by the central government, and therefore House Toras."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You don't need to worry about plea..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need to worry about pleasing our house in this region, though. It's more crucial to retain the favor of the major corporations that are based here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nonsense. It's the corporations wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonsense. It's the corporations who should be concerned with winning *my* favor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is Su Omina still based there?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is Su Omina still based there?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""They are. In fact, the group took..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are. In fact, the group took to the streets in celebration of your coronation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not the Wehzeks who are the d..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not the Wehzeks who are the danger. It's bigotry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll find a way to help him out.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll find a way to help him out."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That would be most kind of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "That would be most kind of you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The crime statistics are not bigot..."
entries.dialogueText: "The crime statistics are not bigoted, Your Majesty. If we do not acknowledge this problem, it will get worse."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Understood. If our economy takes a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Understood. If our economy takes a hit, another uprising won't be far behind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Doesn't House Toras run any corpor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Doesn't House Toras run any corporations?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Some minor relations do. But most..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some minor relations do. But most of our house's wealth comes from our land and natural gas holdings."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Precisely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A healthy perspective, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "A healthy perspective, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Got it. That's all.""
entries.dialogueText: "Got it. That's all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo nodded approvingly."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo nodded approvingly.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Pales Administrative District..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Pales Administrative District is also under the jurisdiction of Rizia Imperii since we won it back in the Reclamation War."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Lest we forget, Wehlen is schedule..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lest we forget, Wehlen is scheduled to return Zille to Rizia next year. The Sazons expect the region to become part of their province, as it was before the uprising."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The power balance between the hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "The power balance between the houses is fragile enough. Adding so much land to Brenas would upset it beyond repair."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's very presumptuous of them.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's very presumptuous of them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can use it as a bargaining chip...."
entries.dialogueText: "I can use it as a bargaining chip. Stay loyal to the crown, or no Zille for House Sazon."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As king, you have the authority to..."
entries.dialogueText: "As king, you have the authority to make Zille part of the central government, similar to Rizia Imperii. An option to keep in mind."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Now you're thinking like a king.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now you're thinking like a king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't see any downside to that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see any downside to that."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's a lot of land, including two..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a lot of land, including two strategic harbors. Allowing the Sazons to regain the power they had before the uprising would be unwise."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You must be aware of their patriar..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must be aware of their patriarch Taddeus' poor health. The General suffered a stroke just prior to King Valero's death."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Father was fond of him.""
entries.dialogueText: "Father was fond of him."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You've already made strengthening..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've already made strengthening the Rizian armed forces a high priority. That should endear you to them right off the bat."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As for Angelica herself... she rem..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for Angelica herself... she remains in exile. As she should."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Exile's too good for her. Why can'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exile's too good for her. Why can't I just have her killed?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's lip twitched."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's lip twitched.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Aside from the fact that doing so..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aside from the fact that doing so would turn all of Brenas against you... there is no evidence she did anything wrong."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""There are even whispers that she t..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are even whispers that she turned her husband in not to save her own skin, but to aid in the monarchy's preservation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She did nothing wrong. Why does sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "She did nothing wrong. Why does she still have to suffer for it after all these years?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Sazon matriarch is a powerful..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazon matriarch is a powerful figure, Your Majesty. Even all these years later, she commands the loyalty of the entire province of Brenas."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I do not deny that she could be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not deny that she could be a useful ally. But only as long as you stay on her house's good side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If Angelica is in exile and Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Angelica is in exile and Manus has not laid claim to the Duke position, who's officially in charge of Brenas now?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo checked his notes."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo checked his notes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A lesser relation by the name of L..."
entries.dialogueText: "A lesser relation by the name of Leona. She reigns from Sallabes."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But it is Manus and Angelica that..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it is Manus and Angelica that the rest of the Sazons take their cues from."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""From what I've been hearing, the P..."
entries.dialogueText: "From what I've been hearing, the PR campaign you spearheaded over the last several years endeared you to them greatly. Keep up the good work."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need to continue. I'm up to spe..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to continue. I'm up to speed on the houses' activities."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo gave a short sniff."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo gave a short sniff.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I see. Then this will be a short m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. Then this will be a short meeting indeed."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""They are working with Ricardus to..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are working with Ricardus to preserve whatever fragile order exists in the city, yes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May God bless him with a full reco..."
entries.dialogueText: "May God bless him with a full recovery."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed."
